title: A second order expression in TOPN breaks the tie
query: EVALUATE TOPN ( 2, Player, Player[Score], DESC, Player[Name], ASC )

source.quote: -- Multiple sorting criteria can be provided in further parameters.
source.supports: the page shows the tied result shrinking to N rows once a second sort expression is added

source.quote: If there is a tie, in Order_By values, at the N-th row of the table, then all tied rows are returned.
source.supports: ties at the N-th row are all returned

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. By score descending, then name ascending: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, ... The first two rows are Ann and Bob, and Bob no longer ties with Cho because the names differ.
